Senior Lead AI Engineering (LangGraph / Haystack / RAG Systems)
Location: India (Remote / Hybrid)
Experience: 8 12 Years
Department: AI Data Engineering
Reports To: Director AI Platform Engineering
About Codvo.ai
At Codvo.ai, we are building NeIO an AI-native enterprise platform powering intelligent operations across industries like Oil Gas, Mortgage, and Legal. NeIO fuses Data Engineering, AI Agents, and MLOps into production-ready, auditable systems that drive real business outcomes. You ll lead a Fusion Team blending data engineers, AI developers, and domain experts to design scalable, explainable, and high-performance AI workflows that bring automation to life.
Role Overview
As Senior Lead AI Engineering, you will own the end-to-end architecture, delivery, and optimization of enterprise RAG (Retrieval- mented Generation) and agentic systems. You will lead a small team of AI engineers to build and deploy LangGraph, Haystack, and FastAPI-based pipelines that extract, enrich, and reason over unstructured data.

This role combines technical leadership, hands-on development, and system design ensuring every AI service meets enterprise-grade standards of performance, reliability, and governance.
Key Responsibilities
Architect Lead: Design and oversee RAG pipelines using LangGraph, Haystack, LangChain, and OpenAI APIs for NeIO applications.
Mentor Guide: Manage a team of 3 5 AI engineers; perform code reviews, pair programming, and architecture reviews.
Build Integrate: Develop FastAPI-based microservices and vectorized retrieval layers (Qdrant, FAISS, Pinecone).
Optimize Scale: Tune embedding quality, latency, and retrieval precision across multi-tenant data lakes.
Collaborate with Data GIS Teams: Integrate structured and spatial data using PostGIS, QGIS, GeoPandas.
Implement Governance: Establish model observability, explainability metrics, and audit trails.
Drive Delivery: Translate business workflows (e.g., LeaseOps, Recon) into AI automation pipelines with measurable ROI.
Evangelize Open Source AI: Advocate for enterprise-grade, open-source-first design principles.

Who You Are
Passionate about building AI systems that move from prototype to production.
Experienced in open-source frameworks and eager to extend them for enterprise readiness.
Strong in data modeling, ontology design, and prompt engineering.
Collaborative, detail-oriented, and comfortable leading agile, cross-functional teams.
Excited to turn complex real-world data maps, leases, documents into actionable intelligence.
Why Join Codvo.ai
Build on the NeIO platform, a rapidly evolving enterprise AI stack.
Lead real-world agentic AI systems for billion-dollar industries.
Collaborate with a global team of AI researchers, domain SMEs, and engineers.
Competitive compen ion with performance-linked RSUs.
Flexible, in ation-driven environment with direct impact on product evolution.
